Q. How does a woodworking newbie ensure the tools used for the build are properly set before using on their project? Is there some specific way of handling each piece of wood?  
A.: Absolutely – setting things straight is crucial when getting comfortable woodworking. To start:

Always double-checked all of tool calibars – check if your hand saw blades are set to the right kerfe (typically around the width plus one-third to one-fours of that) and if jigs, planes are sharp.
